newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish leaders call surprise news conference.
newsitem.headline: Danish leaders call surprise news conference.

text.p: The Danish government on Wednesday announced an 11.15 GMT news conference by Prime Minister Poul Nyrup Rasmussen, Finance Minister Mogens Lykketoft and Economy Minister Marianne Jelved but gave no indication what the subject would be.

A political source said that following a special cabinet meeting at 09.00 GMT and talks with parliamentary party lieutenants the ministers would present their economic strategy to the year 2005 and unveil plans to slash state debt.
The Danish newspaper Politiken said that the plan would also include fresh investment in education and cuts in income tax and said that the draft constituted the first stage of an election campaign.
General elections are due by September 1998 and the minority coalition government, led by Rasmussen's Social Democrats, has said it has no plans at present to call polls before the end of its term.
"My opinion is that our wish is to continue to the very end," Lykketoft said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television last week.
